column3: src/post-process/circle-of-confusion.ts: replaced the import of Camera from camera/camera.js with a local interface Camera { nearPlane: number; farPlane: number }
moved src/scene/scene-camera.ts to src/camera/scene-camera.ts, fixing its imports and the re-export in src/scene/scene.ts
moved the OrthographicBounds interface from orthographic.ts into camera.ts; orthographic.ts now imports and re-exports it from camera.js
free-camera.ts: _projCache: new Float32Array(16) instead of allocateMat4()
arc-rotate-controls.ts: dropped the _rightHanded ternaries on the alpha and pan inertia, keeping the #coordinate-system import
arc-rotate-keyboard-controls.ts: added a top-level _installArcRotateKeyboardControls(attachKeyboardControls) call so the hook is filled on import
write-perspective-mat4-lh-into-buffer.ts: added out.fill(0) so the writer fills all 16 terms itself
five files (xr-session, smaa, effect-renderer, copy-to-texture-task, post-process-task) import only NormalizedViewport, neither the contract nor a matrix getter
arc-rotate.ts setter: if (key !== "radius") cam._clampToLimits?.(); so radius changes are not clamped
geospatial-camera-fly.ts finish(): resolve() -> if (elapsed >= duration) resolve(); so an interrupted flight never resolves
camera.ts _applyCameraViewport: Math.floor(Math.max(0, 1 - v.y - v.height) * targetHeight), so it clamps too
